title.en: List the five sources of human capital formation

say.en: School fees, a hospital bill, a training course, a bus ticket to a city job, and a newspaper. What do these five spendings have in common? In this lesson: List the five sources of human capital formation.
Explain each with an example.

body.en: Investment in *education* is the main source of human capital: individuals spend on education expecting higher future income, just as firms invest in machines. Expenditure on health, both preventive and curative, makes a person more productive; a sick worker without access to medical care must stay away from work.
body.kn: ಶಿಕ್ಷಣದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಮಾನವ ಬಂಡವಾಳದ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಮೂಲ. ಭವಿಷ್ಯದ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಆದಾಯಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಜನರು ಶಿಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೆ ಖರ್ಚು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಆರೋಗ್ಯದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಖರ್ಚು (ತಡೆಗಟ್ಟುವ ಮತ್ತು ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸಾ) ಉತ್ಪಾದಕತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: Five sources of human capital

say.en: Human capital grows from five kinds of investment.
Education is the main source. Health, both preventive and curative, keeps workers productive.
On-the-job training, migration for better jobs and information about jobs complete the list.
Migration pays if the gain beats the cost: 3,000 a month extra repays 6,000 in two months.

body.en: Firms spend on on-the-job *training* so that workers become more productive; the firm gains from the extra output. People migrate from rural to urban areas or abroad for better jobs; the cost of migration is worth it if earnings in the new place are higher. Spending on acquiring information about the labour market, education and health also helps people use their human capital well.
body.kn: ಉದ್ಯೋಗದಲ್ಲಿನ ತರಬೇತಿ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರ ಉತ್ಪಾದಕತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಉತ್ತಮ ಉದ್ಯೋಗಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ವಲಸೆ ಹೋಗುವ ವೆಚ್ಚವೂ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ. ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ, ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ, ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕುರಿತ ಮಾಹಿತಿಗಾಗಿ ಮಾಡುವ ಖರ್ಚೂ ಮಾನವ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ರಚನೆಗೆ ಮೂಲ.

say.en: Treat migration as an investment and find its payback period.

problem.en: A worker earns ₹15,000 a month in his village. A city job pays ₹22,000 a month, but living there costs ₹4,000 a month more, and moving costs ₹6,000 once. In how many months does migration pay back?

steps.en: After 2 months every month adds ₹3,000: migration is a sound investment.

answer.en: The move pays for itself in 2 months.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. A worker earns ₹15,000 a month in his village. A city job pays ₹22,000 a month, but living there costs ₹4,000 a month more, and moving costs ₹6,000 once. In how many months does migration pay back?

say.en: Let us work through this together. A worker earns 15,000 rupees a month in his village. A city job pays 22,000 rupees a month, but living there costs 4,000 rupees a month more, and moving costs 6,000 rupees once. In how many months does migration pay back?
Net monthly gain equals 22,000 minus 15,000 minus 4,000 equals 3,000 rupees.
Payback equals 6,000 divided by 3,000 equals 2 months.
After 2 months every month adds 3,000 rupees: migration is a sound investment.
So the answer is The move pays for itself in 2 months.
